_doc: Calibrated linkage false-alarm-rate (FPP) operating point for same-night discovery. Produced by calibrate_link_fpp.py via a cross-epoch-permutation Monte Carlo of false linkages vs ADCNN score floor; lambda_FP is expected FALSE tracks/night.
calibration_basis: pooled 11 night-fields (run_2v_0706 + run_band x10); 3-visit: S=0.70 lambda_FP=0.002, S=0.80 0/660 trials (predicted ~3e-5), NY2 recovered
two_visit_note: 2-visit CANNOT reach 3 sigma at this FP density (S* ~ 0.97 where real NEOs are lost; caps ~2 sigma). 2visit tracks are candidate-grade only.
cadence_note: 3-visit discovery requires fields with >=3 same-night revisits; spread-out fields recover 0 (cadence-gated, not algorithm-limited).
